# doom-cli

> Unified cross-platform CLI tool, curated engine configurations, and launcher presets for classic Doom source
> ports (DSDA-Doom, UZDoom).

## Overview

`github.com/lock14/doom-cli` provides a static, zero-dependency Go CLI (`doom`) that automates Doom source port
management, engine configuration deployment with display auto-detection, Steam and GOG game file discovery,
multi-mirror community megawad downloading, and interactive terminal launching across Linux, macOS, and Windows.

## Quick start

```bash
# Automated full setup (engines, configs, soundfonts, Steam IWADs, community WADs)
doom setup

# Interactive terminal launcher with fuzzy search and preview pane
doom play

# Direct launch with custom engine or flags
doom launch "Eviternity II"
doom launch "Ancient Aliens" -e dsda-doom -skill 4
```

## CLI command tree

- `doom setup`: Full automated turnkey setup in a single step.
- `doom [args]` or `doom play [args]`: Interactive TUI preset launcher powered by Bubble Tea, forwarding pass-through
  engine flags (such as `doom -skill 4`) to the selected source port.
- `doom launch <preset> [args]`: Direct preset execution with optional engine overrides and game flags.
- `doom engines list`: Lists all configured engines (built-in and custom) and checks binary paths.
- `doom engines add <name>`: Registers a custom source port engine in `catalog.d/engine.<id>.json`.
- `doom engines config <name>`: Configures per-engine overrides in `catalog.d/override.engine.<id>.json`.
- `doom engines remove <name>`: Removes a custom engine from the user catalog.
- `doom engines install [engine|all]`: Downloads portable engine binaries (`uzdoom`, `dsda-doom`, or custom recipes).
- `doom soundfont install`: Downloads and installs curated Roland SC-55 SoundFont (`GeneralUser-GS.sf2`).
- `doom wads extract`: Auto-discovers and imports official Steam and GOG commercial IWADs and expansions, and
  synthesizes `idkfa 2024.wad` from `extras.wad`.
- `doom wads fetch [preset|all]`: Downloads and extracts community megawads from idgames mirrors.
- `doom wads list`: Inspects downloadable community megawads, expected files, and on-disk readiness
  (`[✓ Found: ...]` or `[✗ Missing]`).
- `doom presets list`: Lists all presets (built-in and custom), engine assignments, and on-disk readiness
  (`[✓ Ready]` or `[✗ Missing]`).
- `doom presets show <name>`: Displays resolved launch configuration, sources, links, and file availability.
- `doom presets add <name>`: Adds a custom WAD or preset to `catalog.d/preset.<id>.json`.
- `doom presets config <name>`: Configures per-preset overrides in `catalog.d/override.preset.<id>.json`.
- `doom presets remove <name>`: Removes a custom preset or clears overrides for a built-in preset.
- `doom presets lint`: Validates curated and user entity files, schema invariants, and `README.md` parity.
- `doom presets build`: Hidden maintainer command that synchronizes curated `catalog/*.json` preset table into
  `README.md`.
- `doom config show`: Displays effective CLI settings (`flag`, `env`, `config`, or `default`) and source annotations.
- `doom config get <key>`: Retrieves an effective configuration value (`theme`, `nerd-fonts`, `wads-dir`, `wads-dirs`,
  `bin-dir`, `soundfonts-dir`).
- `doom config set <key> <val>`: Sets a persistent configuration value in `config.json`.
- `doom config toggle <key>`: Toggles a boolean configuration setting (such as `nerd-fonts`).
- `doom config install`: Deploys engine configuration files with native display auto-detection and backups.
- `doom config diff`: Shows differences between repository templates and live installed configs.
- `doom config sync`: Hidden maintainer command that pulls in-game tweaks back from the host system into repository
  templates.
- `doom themes list`: Lists built-in and custom JSON color themes with ANSI color swatches.
- `doom themes set <name>`: Sets persistent launcher color theme.
- `doom completion <shell>`: Generates shell autocompletion for bash, zsh, fish, or powershell.

## Global flags and environment variables

Settings resolve in four-tier precedence order (`CLI flags` take precedence over `DOOM_*` environment variables, which
take precedence over `config.json`, which takes precedence over platform defaults):

- Global flags: `--engine` (`-e`), `--wads-dir`, `--wads-dirs`, `--bin-dir`, `--soundfonts-dir`, `--presets-file`,
  `--theme`, `--nerd-fonts`, `--once`, `--dry-run`.
- Environment variables: `DOOM_CONFIG_DIR`, `DOOM_THEME`, `DOOM_NERD_FONTS`, `DOOM_WADS_DIR`, `DOOM_WADS_DIRS`,
  `DOOM_BIN_DIR`, `DOOM_SF_DIR`.

## Architecture and modular packages

- `embed.go`: Single root `embed.FS` embedding `catalog/*.json`, `dsda-doom/dsda-doom.cfg`, and `uzdoom/autoexec.cfg`.
- `catalog/`: Per-entity curated JSON files (`engine.<id>.json`, `preset.<id>.json`).
- `cmd/doom/`: Modular Cobra CLI commands:
  - `main.go`: Entrypoint, root command, global flags, and path helpers.
  - `play.go`: `doom play` interactive Bubble Tea launcher.
  - `launch.go`: `doom launch` direct execution.
  - `setup.go`: `doom setup` automated turnkey workflow.
  - `wads.go`: `doom wads` subcommands (`list`, `fetch`, `extract`).
  - `engines.go`: `doom engines` subcommands (`list`, `add`, `config`, `remove`, `install`).
  - `presets.go`: `doom presets` subcommands (`list`, `show`, `add`, `config`, `remove`, `build` (hidden), `lint`).
  - `soundfont.go`: `doom soundfont install`.
  - `config.go`: `doom config` subcommands (`show`, `get`, `set`, `toggle`, `install`, `diff`, `sync` (hidden)).
  - `themes.go`: `doom themes` subcommands (`list`, `set`).
- `internal/config/`: Cross-platform path resolution adhering to XDG, Library, and AppData (`paths.go`), plus
  settings-only `config.json` (`settings.go`).
- `internal/display/`: Native display resolution and refresh rate auto-detection.
- `internal/engine/`: Declarative source port binary installation and argument synthesis (`runner.go`, `installer.go`).
- `internal/fsutil/`: Atomic file writes with timestamped backups and path-containment helpers (`fsutil.go`).
- `internal/preset/`: Two-layer entity catalog, store operations, schema and documentation linting, multi-root file and
  alias resolution, CP437 decoding, and README sync (`preset.go`, `store.go`, `lint.go`, `resolve.go`, `decode.go`,
  `compiler.go`).
- `internal/steam/`: Multi-library `libraryfolders.vdf` parsing, catalog-driven game file extraction (prioritizing
  `rerelease/` candidates over `base/`), and `idkfa 2024.wad` soundtrack synthesis from `extras.wad`.
- `internal/templates/`: Embedded configuration templates and backup deployment engine.
- `internal/tui/`: Interactive Bubble Tea launcher (`launcher.go`, `options.go`, `config_view.go`, `layout.go`,
  `render.go`, `menu.go`, `theme.go`, `builtin_themes.go`).
- `internal/wad/`: Multi-mirror SHA-256 verified downloader, Zip Slip hardened extractor, embedded `DEHACKED` lump
  extractor, ranked `.txt` README extractor with `<primaryStem>.txt` fallback normalization, and SoundFont installer
  (`downloader.go`, `extract.go`, `soundfont.go`).
- `.agents/`: Conditional TUI design rules (`.agents/rules/monospace-tui.md`) and `mono-tui v0.2.5` design and audit
  skills (`.agents/skills/mono-tui-design/`, `.agents/skills/mono-tui-audit/`).

## Key design invariants

- **Single source of truth**: Curated engines and presets are defined one-entity-per-file in `catalog/*.json`, with
  user entities and overrides layered from `<ConfigDir>/catalog.d/*.json`.
- **Catalog-driven WAD aliases and Steam synthesis**: Alternate filename stems (`files[].aliases`) are declared once in
  `catalog/preset.<id>.json` and `<ConfigDir>/catalog.d/*.json`; `preset.DirIndex` and `steam.DefaultTargetPatterns()`
  synthesize their lookup tables directly from the catalog alongside normalized filename matching
  (`preset.NormalizeFilename`).
- **Portability**: Configuration templates use `__RESOLUTION__`, `__REFRESH_RATE__`, and `__SOUNDFONT__` placeholders.
- **Destructive safety**: Atomic writes and non-clobbering timestamped backups (`.bak.<timestamp>`, retaining at most
  `MaxBackupsPerFile = 3` per file and cleaning up orphaned `.bak.*` files via `fsutil.RemoveBackups` on entity or
  override deletion and `doom config sync`) are created before modifying existing user files.
- **Archive security**: Zip Slip and path traversal prevention via `fsutil.SafeJoin` and SHA-256 verification.
- **Strict line length (120 columns)**: Code enforced at 120 columns via `revive.toml` and `.editorconfig`.
